Pairwise TV differences were: Raw - RealTime = 0.0644 [0.0216, 0.1073], Raw - Hybrid = 0.0951 [0.0393, 0.1586], RealTime - Hybrid = 0.0308 [0.0043, 0.0665].

For Raw ByteTrack, wrong-ID exposure showed a stronger rank association with profile distortion than IDSW (delta abs rho = 0.0668 [0.0116, 0.1501]); for RealTime-Fast, the interval included zero (delta abs rho = 0.0512 [-0.0006, 0.1577]); Hybrid was degenerate due to near-zero error.

The 33,287 canonical units constitute the 5-fold cross-validation development cohort; an independent outer test cohort was defined in protocol but not materialized, resulting in zero outer evaluations.
